YoshTool — popup-blocker test fixture

Serve this over http (not file:// — content scripts don't run there) and open it with the extension loaded. For the clearest test, turn Strict mode ON in the popup blocker so every window.open is blocked.

Setup: in the YoshTool popup → Tools → Popup blocker: Enable it (grant all-sites), then tick Strict, and make sure “Remember my choice … after N s” is on. Reload this page.

1 · Trigger a popup (window.open) per host

Each button opens a popup to a different host, so the per-host memory is observable and independent.

2 · target=_blank link (blocked only in Strict mode)

open example.com in new tab

3 · Programmatic popunder (no user gesture — blocked even in default mode)

A window.open with no recent click is a “popunder”. Default mode blocks these; Strict blocks everything.

What to look for

  1. First click on example.com → the bar appears with Allow / Block / Trust / Background / Redirect, no countdown. Click Allow.
  2. Click example.com again → the bar now shows a countdown (5s) on Allow and auto-opens at 0.
  3. Click example.org → no countdown (different host, nothing remembered). Click Block; click it again → countdown auto-Blocks.
  4. While a countdown runs, click Keep open → it stops and waits for you.
  5. Popup → Tools: toggle Remember… off → countdown gone; change the seconds; Forget remembered choices resets everything.
  6. Trust domain on example.com → next example.com popup opens instantly (no bar), and its remembered choice is cleared.
